description: Görlitz Rail Test Center CV Dataset 2024 (RailGoerl24) is a data set deposited in wuua.vozxlg by its authors Rustam Tagiew, Ilkay Wunderlich (Federal Railway Authority https://ror.org/0392kk689). RailGoerl24 is an on-board visual light Full-HD camera dataset consisting of 12,205 frames and 383,922,305 off-board LiDAR colored cloud points recorded in a railway test center of TÜV SÜD Rail, in Görlitz, Germany, on April 24th, 2024. Coverage: national (DE); the metadata date the deposit to 2024. Formats: TXT, Point cloud. Size stated: 0 kb. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC0 1.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
